label: Double Extension, Hook & Button
description: A double extension waistband carries two overlapping extended tabs that fasten across the front, doubling the closure and creating an especially clean, supported waist. The layered tabs distribute strain and give a sharp, finished front for beltless wear. It is a refined detail on high-waisted bespoke and military-style trousers.
